description.en:
Script Sentry is a read-only conflict, GUI-integrity, and frame-rate diagnostic utility for Farming Simulator 25.
It watches for mods that replace the same live Lua function and monitors loaded GUI screens for persistent, high-confidence faults. The player report shows only confirmed problems. Normal menu population, dynamic option-list changes, controller rebinding, settings-map reconstruction, speculative GUI risks, and compatible shared-script chains are never presented as conflicts.
Each confirmed problem is explained with four plain-language lines: - Mod: the responsible mod, when it can be identified reliably - Problem: what the mod broke - Affects: the visible menu or controls involved - What to do: the recommended player action
Internal control paths, callback names, raw evidence, compatible chains, and uncertain observations remain in log.txt for mod authors. The dialog shows one confirmed problem per page and never exceeds three pages. Its title includes version 0.5.3.0 so players can verify that the hotfix actually loaded.
The confidence-first GUI monitor still catches strong evidence such as mapped settings choices being replaced by OFF/ON or YES/NO, persistent invalid states, broken mod-owned callbacks/layout data, invalid geometry, and detached controls which remain in use. Screens and selectors which initialize empty are learned instead of being reported as corrupt.
Version 0.5.3 also recognizes when a GUI overhaul retires and replaces a complete screen layer during normal startup. The replacement becomes the new structural baseline, while isolated removed controls that remain in use are still reported.
The review remains visible until the player presses SPACE. When closed, it leaves no badge, icon, or message on the gameplay HUD. Press RIGHT ALT + 1 at any time to view it again. Reviews are split into clearly numbered pages; close the current page with SPACE and press RIGHT ALT + 1 for the next one.
At startup, Script Sentry honors the shared diagnostic-dialog handoff used by Know Your Limits. Know Your Limits can show and close its one-page startup notice first; Script Sentry then opens its review without either mod replacing the other mod's text or callback. This coordination applies only to automatic startup dialogs and does not change either mod's on-demand controls.
Press RIGHT ALT + 2 while the slowdown is happening to run a safe 15-second FPS check. It reports average FPS, the slowest frame, whether low-FPS frames or stutters were captured, and a plain-language next step. It does not name a mod.
Version 0.5.2 removes the earlier per-mod callback profiler. That profiler placed timing wrappers inside other mods' live gameplay chains even when no sample was running. Script Sentry now leaves gameplay hooks, event listeners, and specialization callbacks exactly unchanged. This avoids misleading error stacks and removes that compatibility risk.
Script Sentry has no settings, profiles, resolution tools, telemetry, or saved database. Its dialogs and log evidence remain local and informational. During mod initialization it temporarily observes GIANTS' official registration and wrapper-construction helpers, always passing the exact original mod hook into the game. Persistent lightweight GUI observers forward all calls unchanged. Script Sentry never replaces source(), changes a watched gameplay function, repairs GUI data, changes another mod, picks a winner, reorders scripts, parks a mod, or captures generic log errors.
The GUI monitor detects observable structural and data-integrity faults. It cannot judge artistic quality, intended colors/spacing, every custom renderer, or whether technically valid behavior matches a mod author's intent.
It adds two remappable actions: Script Sentry: Open startup review, assigned to RIGHT ALT + 1, and Script Sentry: Run safe 15-second FPS check, assigned to RIGHT ALT + 2. SPACE is not added as another binding; each dialog uses FS25's existing MENU_ACTIVATE action while the game is in its modal menu context. Script Sentry never edits inputBinding.xml or changes an existing binding.
PC/Mac script mod. Singleplayer diagnostic preview.
